scope: New Middle/Late weather advice provenance and unchanged real forecast readiness; no agent or judge evaluation.
hypothesis: New get-weather-advice computes a latitude-only temperature (30 - abs(latitude)/3 rounded and clamped) without observing weather or time. Its output cannot establish a real forecast. Native get-forecast is the required alternative only if it returns actual NWS forecast periods.

task_relevance.basis: Question-only inventory: forecast for a photo shoot near Los Angeles, then a persisted project and gear task based on forecast. No reference answers or scored trajectories consumed.

acceptance: Early catalog has no get-weather-advice; Middle and Late expose it.

In both changed stages, synthetic latitude 12 with longitudes -20 and 140 produces the same 26 C estimated-temperature text; longitude only changes the echoed coordinates. Source confirms absence of weather/time acquisition in this function; a two-input test alone does not prove all inputs.

All three native get-forecast calls for 34.05,-118.24 return forecast headers and multiple named periods with actual temperature, wind, and forecast text; error strings or empty response are failure even if isError is false.

No mocked weather, altered native source, patched SDK, or new external write. Existing model budgets remain unchanged. All failed calls and stderr retained. No retries; stop at unrecoverable startup/catalog failure and preregister continuation for unexecuted calls only.
A new candidate and independent quality/completion schedule may be registered only after readiness passes. This probe does not establish agent efficacy or completion headroom.
